hypothesis: V32 tied the WAIT classification logits to the payoff score, and its ensemble rank correlation was -0.00178 versus +0.00135 for the causal constant control. Keep the causal 48-wide GRU, closed-candle sequence, train-only normalization, 730-day matured-label window, folds, 8-day embargo and fixed policy, but give candidate-vs-WAIT action selection its own logits: each candidate receives an action logit and the shared context receives a WAIT logit. The inference adapter uses the fixed candidate-minus-WAIT logit margin at 1 percentage point per logit for the unchanged .3% policy gate, while a separate fill head remains responsible for fill probability. A small margin-regression term anchors the otherwise shift-invariant classifier to percent-scale realized utility. This tests an explicit action-selection adapter, not a tied score loss or post-hoc calibration.
selection: The separate action head, fixed 1.0 margin scale, loss weights and temperature are registered before cloud training. Fixed 16 epochs, all 3 seeds x 11 contiguous folds, no winner-seed/fold/threshold/branch selection. The 8-day label-end embargo remains fixed. All dates are opened development, not an independent test.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; report gross, fees, funding, coverage and fills. No live approval.
